backgroundPermissionRationale.title: Allow Mowology to track your location in the background?
backgroundPermissionRationale.message: Mowology uses your location during shifts to record GPS breadcrumbs for job proof-of-work tracking and the crew map.

_comment_plugins: @capacitor-community/background-geolocation  — foreground service, GPS watcher, activity recognition adapter
MwTracking (custom AAR)                      — Room DB persistence, WorkManager batch sync,
Source: contact @TLSchofield for the native plugin repo.
_comment_build: 1. npm install  (or yarn)  — install Capacitor + plugin deps
2. npx cap sync android    — copy web assets + sync plugin config
3. npx cap open android    — open in Android Studio
MwTracking plugin is distributed as a pre-built AAR.
Place MwTracking.aar in android/app/libs/ before syncing.
Keystore credentials are NOT stored here.
Store in environment variables or Android Studio's signing config.
Minimum Android SDK: 26 (Android 8.0 — required by WorkManager v2.x + Room)
